notes.title: We're at the festival! Try our demo & support the project!
notes.content:
Friends, this is a huge moment for us – we're finally showcasing our game demo at the festival! For months, we've eaten, slept, and breathed game dev, going through countless item iterations, endless bugs, and those rare "eureka" moments.



Why check it out?
• Unique genre blend – we've built something we truly believe in
• Dozens of "perfect" items – each redesigned repeatedly (yes, we write tests now!)
• Authentic demo – not just cut content, but the essence of our vision



We know the game isn't perfect yet. But that's the magic of indie dev – we get to shape it together with you. Your support means everything right now:



🌟 Wishlist it – the best way to help us grow
💬 Join our Discord – we want your ideas & feedback
📢 Tell friends – word-of-mouth is priceless for small studios



Links:
🎮 Play the festival demo
📌 Steam wishlist
🗣️ Discord server



Thanks for believing in us through all the "rake-stepping"! There's much work ahead, but with your support, we'll make it happen.

#IndieDev #SteamFest #GameMechanics #Roguelike

(P.S. What aspect interests you most? Ask us anything in the comments!)
